```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)
library(bcmaps)
```

```{r FWI}
t.26 <- rast(here("Data","ClimateDataCanada","May_to_September_95th_percentile_of_FWI_RCP8.5_2021-2050_.nc")) # for terra package
print(t.26)
#plot(t.26)
#add bc boundary
bc <- bcmaps::bc_bound() %>%
  vect()
bc_proj <- project(bc, t.26)
t.26bc <- mask(crop(t.26, bc_proj), bc_proj)
t.26bc <- project(t.26bc, crs(bc)) #turns it back to the BC specific projection
plot(t.26bc, main = "BC May_to_September_95th_percentile_of_FWI_RCP8.5_2021-2050")
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 2)

climate_layer <- t.26bc[[1]] 

```

```{r OSF}
osf <- rast(here("Data", "ebird_distributions", "Olive-sided_Flycatcher_abundance_full-year_max_3km_BC.tif"))
#plot(osf, main = "Olive-sided Flycatcher Mean Seasonal Abundance")


# 
bc_proj<- project(bc, osf)
osf.bc <- mask(crop(osf, bc_proj), bc_proj)
osf_final <- project(osf.bc, crs(bc)) %>%  trim()
# 
#png("Olive_sided_Flycatcher.png", width = 1600, height = 1200, res = 200)
plot(osf_final,
     main = "Olive-sided Flycatcher",  	col = viridis::viridis(100, option = "D"))
lines(bc,
      col = "black",
      lwd = 2)

#
climate_aligned <- resample(climate_layer, osf_final, method = "near") 
risk_map <- osf_final * climate_aligned
##

png(here("Maps", "osf.panel.png"), width = 3000, height = 1000, pointsize = 24)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2)) 
# Plot Map 2: Climate Data

plot(climate_aligned, 
     main = "FWI RCP8.5 2021-2050",
     col = hcl.colors(100, "Inferno") # Use a strong heat palette for FWI
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

# Plot Map 1: Bird Abundance
plot(osf_final, 
     main = "Olive-sided Flycatcher ",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Blues")) 
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

# Plot the resulting composite map

plot(risk_map, 
     main = "FWI * Abundance",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Reds"))
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

#individual maps
png(here("Maps", "osf.risk.png"), width = 1000, height = 1000, pointsize = 24)
#risk
plot(risk_map, 
     main = "Olive-sided Flycatcher Risk",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Reds"))
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

#fwi
png(here("Maps", "fwi.png"), width = 1000, height = 1000, pointsize = 24)
plot(climate_aligned, 
     main = "FWI RCP8.5 2021-2050",
     col = hcl.colors(100, "Inferno") # Use a strong heat palette for FWI
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

#osf
png(here("Maps", "osf.png"), width = 1000, height = 1000, pointsize = 24)
plot(osf_final, 
     main = "Olive-sided Flycatcher ",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Blues")) 
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)


```

```{r bbw}
bbw <- rast(here("Data", "ebird_distributions", "Black-backed_Woodpecker_abundance_resident_seasonal_max_3km_BC.tif"))
plot(bbw, main = "Black-backed Woodpecker Mean Annual Abundance")

#
bc_proj<- project(bc, bbw)
bbw.bc <- mask(crop(bbw, bc_proj), bc_proj)
bbw_final <- project(bbw.bc, crs(bc)) %>%  trim()
# 
plot(bbw_final,
     main = "Black-backed Woodpecker",  	col = viridis::viridis(100, option = "D"))
lines(bc,
      col = "black",
      lwd = 2)

#
climate_aligned <- resample(climate_layer, bbw_final, method = "near") 
risk_map <- bbw_final * climate_aligned
##
#save:
png(here("Maps", "bbw.panel.png"),
    width = 3000, height = 2000, pointsize = 60)

layout(
  matrix(c(
    1, 2,
    3, 3
  ), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
  heights = c(0.8, 1)   # top = 0.7 units, bottom = 1.3 units
)

# Plot Map 2: Climate Data

plot(climate_aligned, 
     main = "a) FWI RCP8.5 2021-2050",
     col = hcl.colors(100, "Inferno") # Use a strong heat palette for FWI
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

# Plot Map 1: Bird Abundance
plot(bbw_final, 
     main = "b) Black-backed Woodpecker distribution",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Blues")) 
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

# Plot the resulting composite map

plot(risk_map, 
     main = "c) FWI * Abundance",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Reds"))
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)
dev.off()
#individual maps
png(here("Maps", "bbw.risk.png"), width = 1000, height = 1000, pointsize = 24)
#risk
plot(risk_map, 
     main = "Black-backed Woodpecker Risk",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Reds"))
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

#abundance
png(here("Maps", "bbw.png"), width = 1000, height = 1000, pointsize = 24)
plot(bbw_final, 
     main = "Black-backed Woodpecker",
     col = rev(hcl.colors(100, "Blues")) 
)
lines(bc, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)


```
